messages.content: "請問您能否提供我過去5年微軟每季的歷史股息資料，然後再提供同樣的資料但是以年為單位？之後，能否幫我取得微軟過去60天和過去120天的股市資料？"

function.name: corporate_finance_dividend_data
function.description: Get historical dividend data of a specific company within a particular duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the dividend data for.

years.description: Number of past years for which to retrieve the data.

frequency.description: The frequency of the dividend payment.

function.name: stock_market_data
function.description: Retrieve stock market data for a specific company and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the stock market data for.

days.description: Number of past days for which to retrieve the data.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) Past 5-year quarterly dividends for Microsoft (MSFT).
2) Same but annualized? They say "but with yearly units". So maybe aggregate per year.

Then they ask for MSFT's stock market data over last 60 days and 120 days.

We have two functions available:
- corporate_finance_dividend_data(company:string, years:number, frequency optional)
- stock_market_data(company:string, days:number)

So we can call corporate_finance_dividend_data twice: once with frequency="quarterly" and years=5; second with frequency omitted or set to "annual"? Actually default is annually. But if we specify frequency="yearly"? Not allowed. Only options: "quarterly"|"annually".

Thus first call: frequency="quarterly".
Second call: no frequency param -> defaults to annually.

But note: For the second request, they might want aggregated yearly totals from the same period. We could just use the annual frequency.

Third part: need stock_market_data for 60 days and 120 days separately.

We'll produce calls accordingly.

Let's do three separate calls: one for quarterly dividends, one for annual dividends, then two for stock data.

Return JSON array of results.

Ok.
